title: Frontend Developer Roadmap
description: Become a job-ready Frontend Developer. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and modern web development practices used in real-world companies.

Syllabus.title: Web Fundamentals
Syllabus.description: Master the building blocks of the web: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Lesson: CSS Basics: selectors, box model, layout
Responsive Design with Flexbox and Media Queries
JavaScript Basics: variables, control flow, DOM

Syllabus.title: Version Control with Git
Syllabus.description: Track code changes and collaborate using Git and GitHub.
Lesson: Git basics: init, add, commit, push

Syllabus.title: Advanced JavaScript
Syllabus.description: Go deeper into JavaScript to write modern, clean, and efficient code.
Lesson: ES6+ Features: let/const, arrow functions, spread/rest
Asynchronous JS: Promises, async/await, fetch API

Syllabus.title: Modern UI with React
Syllabus.description: Build dynamic, component-based applications using React.

Syllabus.title: State Management
Syllabus.description: Manage global application state and complex data flows.

Syllabus.title: APIs and Backend Integration
Syllabus.description: Connect to real-world APIs and handle asynchronous data.

Syllabus.title: Build Tools and Optimization
Syllabus.description: Prepare your app for production and optimize performance.

Syllabus.title: Testing Basics
Syllabus.description: Write basic tests to ensure reliability of your frontend code.

Syllabus.title: Deployment and CI/CD
Syllabus.description: Take your project live and set up simple CI/CD pipelines.

Syllabus.title: Portfolio and Projects
Syllabus.description: Build a personal portfolio and real-world projects to showcase your skills.
Lesson: Build a personal website with React
Create a weather app using API
Create a to-do or blog app
